programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Colorado Avalanche host the Los Angeles Kings at Ball Arena to open their 2026-27 NHL regular-season. The Avalanche swept the Kings during the 2025-26 regular-season, outscoring the Kings 13-5 across three consecutive victories.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Philadelphia Flyers host the Pittsburgh Penguins in a Metropolitan Division game. Philadelphia aims to defend home ice after eliminating Pittsburgh in the 2026 playoffs, while Pittsburgh relies on Sidney Crosby, who enters his 22nd NHL season.
